acceptance_predicates.description: The versioned manifest identifies channel, repository, resolved commit, source/build digest, and development-only status.
Stale, malformed, mismatched, and unavailable manifests return typed diagnostics.
The dev resolver points to the configured current main head.

definition_of_done: Deterministic valid and hostile fixtures pass.
Independent review accepts redacted human and JSON provenance.

inputs.description: Configured ASB main head and channel manifest fixtures.

gates.description: Valid dev and all stale/mismatch cases are classified correctly.
